description: This file defines the ProxyMethodDescription class, which models an invokable method on a proxy interface within the Orleans code generation framework. It includes logic for handling type parameters, method metadata, and generating type syntax representations for code generation purposes.

classes.name: ProxyMethodDescription
classes.description: Represents a description of an invokable method on a proxy interface, including type parameters, method metadata, and code generation helpers.

classes.name: ProxyMethodDescription.ConstructedGeneratedInvokableDescription
classes.description: A nested class that provides a detailed description of the generated invokable type, including syntax generation and member management.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a ProxyMethodDescription with given proxy interface, generated invokable, and method symbol.
